notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. IBM's Form 10-K (accession 0000051143-26-000010, filed February 24, 2026) incorporates its financial statements from the 2025 Annual Report filed as Exhibit 13 in the same submission; the figures were read from that exhibit and checked against SEC XBRL. OWNERSHIP: Ginni Rometty retired from IBM on December 31, 2020 and is not a director or named executive; the 2026 proxy (DEF 14A filed March 10, 2026, accession 0000051143-26-000025) does not mention her at all (its pay-versus-performance table now starts after her tenure), so status no-reported-stake, values null, no source. HOLDERS: the 5% table is 'as of December 31, 2025, except to the extent indicated otherwise in the footnotes' and repeats the prior year's rows; each rests on a Schedule 13G whose filing date the proxy gives (Vanguard February 7, 2025; BlackRock January 25, 2024; State Street, footnote 3), so asOf is null and the BlackRock and State Street figures are probably stale. BUYBACKS: 0. IBM's program has been suspended since 2019; the cash-flow statement's only repurchase line is 'Common stock repurchases for tax withholdings' of $1,018 million, which is shares remitted by employees to cover taxes on vesting awards, not a buyback, so it is not counted. STOCK COMP: the Note T total ($1,715 million). GEOGRAPHY: the three-region table in Note C; values rounded from millions, so the segments sum to 67.53 against the stated total of 67,535.

source.quote: The ratio of the Chairman, President and CEO's annual total compensation to that of the median employee's annual total compensation is 765:1. This ratio is based on annual total compensation of $37,989,685 for the Chairman, President and CEO (as reported in the Summary Compensation Table) and $49,630 for the median employee.

pay.notes: Employees: IBM reports its workforce in thousands at December 31, 2025: 264.3 thousand at IBM and wholly owned subsidiaries (used here), plus 8.7 thousand at less-than-wholly owned subsidiaries and a 13.8 thousand complementary workforce (an approximation of full-time equivalents hired under temporary, part-time and limited-term arrangements), which are not added. Payroll: the FY2025 10-K and Annual Report disclose no total staff cost, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median is used; it is the 2025 median (identified October 1, 2025 using annual base pay, all currencies converted to U.S. dollars; the median employee's base salary was $48,001).
